restart: Restart Codex Limit Tray to apply the new language.
taskbarIconHelp: To keep the icon visible by the clock, turn on Codex Limit Tray under Other system tray icons (Windows 11) or Notification area → Select which icons appear on the taskbar (Windows 10). You can also drag it out of the hidden icons menu (↑).
openTaskbarSettingsError: Couldn’t open Settings. Right-click the taskbar and select Taskbar settings.
menuBarIconHelp: The icon appears in the menu bar while the app is running. If it’s hidden on macOS 26 or later, check System Settings → Menu Bar → Allow in the Menu Bar.
autosave: Changes save automatically. Starting at login opens the app in the tray.
earnedResetPrompt: Use one available reset on your Codex limits?
earnedResetUnconfirmed: Codex did not confirm the reset. Check your remaining limits and resets.
noDataHint: Limits will appear after a successful request. See the status below.
signin: Uses your existing Codex sign-in. If needed, sign in with Codex desktop or codex login. The app does not read token files.
polling: Refreshes every 30 seconds. After errors, it waits up to 5 minutes.
demoOffline: Demo mode: networking and saving are disabled.
settingsWarning: Could not load settings. Using defaults.
autoUpdateHint: When enabled, the app checks GitHub at startup and restarts after installing an update.
portableHint: The portable app installs nothing automatically. Installed copies enable automatic updates by default.
manualHint: Check the version here. Install new versions manually from GitHub Releases.
installing: Preparing installation. The app will restart.
updateError: Could not update the app. Try again.
manualInstall: Install the new version manually from GitHub Releases.
noInstaller: This release has no verified Windows installer.
noKey: In-app installation requires a trusted update key.
portableCurrent: This portable version is current. You can install it for your user.
demoUpdates: Demo mode: update checks and installation are disabled.
localBuild: This local build has no update source. Use a build from GitHub Releases.
privacy: The local path may include your username. Hide it before sharing.
login: Sign in to Codex with ChatGPT
codexMissing: Codex not found. Set its path in Settings
codexPath: Specify the full path to the Codex executable
codexRead: Could not get limits. Check your network and Codex sign-in
